svg.title: Build, discover and compare
svg.desc: Whole-library versions retain exact source evidence through search, teaching and rollback Local bulk-library architecture. Release verification and clinical review are separate.
svg.text: Whole-library versions retain exact source evidence through search, teaching and rollback
Automatic extraction verification is not human/clinical approval. Blank or image-only pages are reported; OCR is outside scope.
B EXPLICIT GLOBAL DISCOVERY → ONE SELECTED SOURCE
Activation affects fresh searches; existing conversations, quizzes and citations keep their selected library version.
Provider usage occurs only on explicit build/search/evaluate/teach actions. Default/current control resets call no provider.
Retrieval observations and source provenance do not establish clinical accuracy. Retain all version artifacts for old citations.
LOCAL IMPLEMENTATION • 22 NOV 2026 • Blue = application / service exchange; amber = source or release constraint
